title: MSFS 2024 Marketplace: NEW MD-11 landing challenges & A320neo missions
description:
Ready to push your piloting skills and expand your virtual logbook in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024? Whether you're looking to wrestle a heavy widebody trijet onto challenging runways worldwide or fly iconic low-cost holiday routes across the United States, Perfect Flight has introduced fresh activity packs designed to test your flight deck proficiency.

In this breakdown, we examine these two brand-new marketplace mission expansions to evaluate scenario variety, immersion, audio depth, and airframe requirements:

🛬 SKILL & HANDLING FOCUS: ADVANCED MD-11 LANDINGS
First, we inspect Advanced Challenges: MD-11 Landings. Built specifically for the TFDi Design MD-11 (base aircraft ownership required), this pack tests your manual handling and crosswind abilities across 24 precision landing scenarios across 6 continents. From high-altitude mountain approaches in Bolivia to challenging visual arrivals in Japan, Iceland, France, India, Belgium, the UK, and the USA, this pack delivers high-workload heavy trijet operations.

✈️ COMMERCIAL OPERATIONS & ROUTE ADVENTURES: AMERICA 250
Next, we head into scheduled line flying with the America 250 Allegiant Air package. Flown using the iniBuilds Airbus A320neo, this add-on brings a custom anniversary livery, 12 realistic line missions, authentic aviation flight deck sounds, in-sim mini-browser integration, and full compatibility with online networks like VATSIM.

Which of these challenge packs are you loading up first? Taming the raw power and momentum of the MD-11 on short final, or flying scheduled A320neo routes across America? Let us know in the comments below!

If you enjoy honest, data-driven looks at the Flight Simulator Marketplace without the fluff, make sure to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel, and clear skies on your next departure!
